performance.verdict: Meta carries all 134 leads; Google's $532 spend converts zero — structural leak confirmed.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $532.43 over 28 days with 0 confirmed conversions — every dollar is unattributed spend, not a pixel gap excuse.
5 milestones overdue (earliest Jul 20): Stripe QA, GHL build gaps, stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch — all unconfirmed complete.
GBP actions dropped -100% in the last 7 days (from non-zero to 0); last recorded action was 2026-08-27, 13 days of silence.
3-day Meta signal (Sep 6–8): leads 0+6+10=16 vs prior 3 days (Sep 3–5): 7+5+0=12 — short-term improvement, but weekend zero-days are structural, not fatigue.
GHL shows 167 contacts but only 106 opportunities created and 0 won — 61 contacts never entered the pipeline, suggesting an intake mapping gap.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion tracking immediately; if no call or form event fires in 7 days, pause Google spend entirely.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $532.43 over 28 days with zero recorded conversions — this is a confirmed leak, not a known pixel limitation. Audit the call-campaign conversion action in Google Ads and confirm a fired event exists in the last 7 days. If no conversion event is verified by 2026-09-16, pause all Google spend and shift the daily budget (~$15/day) to Meta. Success check: at least one confirmed conversion event recorded in Google Ads by 2026-09-16.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer; paid landing pages and stack re-test are scaling blockers — flag ⛔ status.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are overdue, the earliest since July 20: Stripe Products QA, GHL build gaps (5 items), end-to-end stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch. Paid landing pages and the stack re-test are marked ⛔ scaling blockers — no budget increases should be approved until these are verified complete. Nacer (Ops) to confirm status on each item by 2026-09-12. Success check: all 5 milestones marked complete with evidence (Loom or test log) by that date.

suggestions.text: Watch GHL intake gap: 61 contacts have no opportunity — re-check on Sep 12 to confirm BWS duplicate-check fix resolved the mapping.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 167 contacts but only 106 opportunities created — 61 contacts (37%) never entered the pipeline. This may trace to the overdue BWS field-mapping and duplicate-check task. Do not treat as an ads problem; this is a CRM intake issue. Re-check opportunity count on 2026-09-12; if the gap has not closed after the BWS fix is confirmed, escalate as a separate intake-leak finding.
